subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Disney Renaissance
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Disney Renaissance.

hook.text: By the 1980s, Disney animation was dying. Then The Little Mermaid changed everything.

buildup.text: From 1989 to 1999, Disney released hit after hit — Beauty and the Beast, Aladdin, The Lion King.

discovery.text: Broadway-style music, stronger stories, and diverse settings fueled the Renaissance.

twist.text: The Renaissance ended when audiences shifted to Pixar's 3D style. Disney had to follow.

climax.text: The Renaissance proved that traditional animation could rival any live-action blockbuster.

punchline.text: Disney saved itself by remembering what it was.

quiz.question: What film is considered the start of the Disney Renaissance?
